what: Over a multi-column Work list, when one case becomes active the other rows fade to .25 over .3s ease-out, that case’s preview photo (different position and size per case) floats up in .3s, and a background-color strip lays down behind the chosen row’s text from the left over .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.55,1) (the description line .1s later) so it stays readable over the photo. The large name cell lights up in .4s, and the name scrambles from blank into uppercase letters and digits, each letter after 28ms × index + 0~25ms, for 64ms before settling. With zone: near, the nearest case lights up wherever the mouse is within the list band, and on devices without a pointer the last case past the line −120px from screen center lights up.

options.zone: If near, the closest case (including empty margins), otherwise only the row under the pointer
options.touch: With off, turns off lighting up along the center line on devices without hover
options.step · jitter · life: Large name letters: stagger interval·wobble·blend time (s), defaults .028 · .025 · .064
options.caption-dur: Time until the name is erased on fade out (sec), default .4
options.--fx-dim · --fx-dur · --fx-idle · --fx-c: (css vars) blur opacity .25 · blur·photo .3s · resting photo opacity .1 · name cell .4s · band .6s · band delay (.1s on description lines)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Work row — data-key (paired with the photo), data-title (large name, otherwise [data-fx-part=name] text), data-sub (small line under the name)
options.[data-fx-part=shot]: Preview photo — same data-key. Position and size come from the user’s css (usually position: fixed)
options.[data-fx-part=caption-box] · caption · c: Large name cell with the name and a small line inside
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: (optional) background color band behind a line of text — the wrapped text must be position: relative
options.fx:show · fx:hide: detail { key, idle } Send it to turn that case on — with idle: true the rows stay unfaded and only the photo is dimmed by --fx-idle (the Hero’s featured case)
options.center-below: Windows narrower than this width (px) switch on along the center line even with hover — the original uses 1024

use: Client Name 01

from.where: index.html .am-cases (27 rows in 3 columns — original project-hover-preview·ProjectTitle: blur .25/300ms · photo opacity·filter 300ms · band 600ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.55,1) delay 100ms · big name 70px 28ms+25ms·64ms·uppercase · cell 400ms)
